description: jcm-strat phase 29 scorecard runs (QBO30 and QBO10dL76 excluded): T63 L95 stratosphere-only JCM, troposphere nudged to ERA5, daily zonal means reduced from 6-hourly output by jcm-strat scripts/daily_zm.py (v'theta' formed within each 6-hourly snapshot). Read in place, never copied.

notes.P20b: baseline; ERA5 nudging top 400 hPa everywhere, no T_eq correction
notes.AL7: P20b with the AL7 equilibrium-temperature correction (jcm-strat phase 22)
notes.AL7t: AL7 correction tapered to zero at 35 deg, full from 50 deg (phase 24)
notes.L0: P20b with the nudging top at 150 hPa in the tropics, 400 hPa in the extratropics (phase 23)
notes.LAL7: L0 nudging top with the AL7 correction (phase 23)
notes.QBO10d: AL7h with the QBO nudging timescale 10 d instead of 1 d (phase 27)
